objective: Complete Gahyeon knowledge base and OpenHuman-inspired memory architecture with strict per-user isolation
constraints: Do not deploy or activate production features without explicit deployment authority
Enforce subject and source authorization filters in SQL and vector retrieval
Keep anonymous or uncertain-speaker memories ephemeral and non-recallable as personal memory
Never mix memories across character, world, or subject namespaces
Propagate user deletion to PostgreSQL, vector indexes, caches, and derived memories
Require explicit user approval before merging pre-link identities
Use immutable ZezeStudio user UUID as the canonical subject when linked

requiredGates.evidence: 2026-08-26 GitNexus upstream analysis: DiscordIdentityMapper LOW (0 direct callers, 0 processes); CharacterConversationMemoryListener CRITICAL (1 direct caller, 87 processes, 20 modules); JpaCharacterMemoryStore CRITICAL lower-bound (1 direct caller, 1 indexed process, 20 modules, 5 interface implementations). User was warned and explicitly directed continuation of the full plan.
